Kill [[Havok Soulwail]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Havok Soulwail in [[Darkrime Delves]].
* *BONUS* Kill Havok Soulwail in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Norn reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coin]]s.
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
The walkthrough is the same for the quest [[The Misanthropic Jotun Principle]] given by [[Einarr Frostcleft]] in [[Bjora Marches]] just west of the entrance to the Darkrime Delves. If you enter without the quest, the door inside will be shut. Einarr and another Norn will follow you during the quest but don't help.
